worked_solution:
We identify the leading term and compute its limit:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to -\infty }(-4{x}^{5}+2x-9) & ={lim}_{x\to -\infty }(-4{x}^{5}) \\  & =-4{lim}_{x\to -\infty }({x}^{5}) \\  & =\infty \,.\end{aligned}
$$
